response: Yes, fragility of the esophageal mucosa is a pathognomonic endoscopic sign of primary eosinophilic esophagitis. This condition is characterized by fragile esophageal mucosa that readily tears in response to minor trauma during diagnostic endoscopy, often referred to as the "crêpe-paper" sign. This sign may alert endoscopists to the presence of the disease, even when other mucosal alterations are lacking.
